response.sql: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), bucket_shares AS (SELECT timespan, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), scored AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS all_bucket_average FROM bucket_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - all_bucket_average) AS average_excess FROM scored WHERE share > all_bucket_average

assumptions.assumption: “That average share” in the excess calculation means the plain average across all buckets, which is also the threshold for keeping a bucket.

alternatives.interpretation: “That average share” means the average share of the kept buckets. The resulting average signed difference is zero, apart from possible floating-point effects.
